authority: #K2-397 sec.3.1: re-derive exam A^4 over the ORIGINAL directive's true scope (the cluster moves DOWN into the J12 vacated band).

per_part_DOWN_derivation.method: regen.rearrange_probe(l14, rect4=[22.95,32.95,51.5,78.0], members, work, direction=(0,1)) - a NEW deterministic direction parameter (default (1,1) = the SE lattice, unchanged).
per_part_DOWN_derivation.diagnosis: the per-part derivation moves U1 FIRST (largest pad area) with every OTHER part still unmoved, so a DOWN shift of U1 runs into J9's band (the mask/copper gate rejects it) - a COHERENT cluster translation can never emerge from a per-part, independence-assuming derivation.
per_part_DOWN_derivation.conclusion: the per-part family is the WRONG sub-family for the original directive (#K2-397 sec.2).

rigid_cluster_translation.method: regen.mech_probe_moves([(ref,0,dy) for ref in members], ...) - ONE identical delta for ALL 25 members (a rigid move).
rigid_cluster_translation.note: a rigid down-shift of 1/2/4 mm introduces ZERO new violations (and even CLEARS the baseline's courtyards_overlap x2, pth_inside_courtyard x1 and all silk classes - raw post-move classes = {}).
rigid_cluster_translation.conclusion: A^4 = a RIGID cluster translation DOWNWARD - exactly the owner's original directive ('left parts move down'). This is the block-move model (block.move_block / relocate_block_chain), not the per-part one.
